instant calibration is the most accurate method to calibrate gas sensors on the fly, and that the accuracy of the sensor readings can be significantly increased by using reliable sensors as references for sensor calibration.
(i) instant and backward calibration are more accurate than forward calibration and (ii) the accuracy can be improved by using a reliable sensor to calibrate the other sensors.

(1) instant calibration outperforms backward calibration, which in turn outperforms forward calibration, (2) instant calibration requires reference measurements, and (3) the accuracy of the reference measurements determines the accuracy of the calibration.
